summary:
好市多EPS小幅低於預期，會員制零售模式仍穩健。
• EPS 4.93美元，略低於預期4.97美元，驚喜幅度-0.85%。
• 單季營收696.0億美元，反映穩定的會員消費與客流。
• 會員費收入提供高毛利、可預測的獲利基礎。
• 高會員續約率（renewal rate）強化營收黏著度。
• 高性價比定位在通膨環境中吸引消費者。
ai_view:
訊號中性：EPS幾近符合預期，僅小幅低於，會員制零售模式展現一貫的穩定性與韌性。短中期股價有高續約率與會員費現金流支撐，防禦性佳。市場焦點在於同店銷售動能與潛在的會員費調漲帶來的獲利彈性。追蹤指標：同店銷售（含與不含油品）、會員續約率、會員費調漲時程、來客數與客單價。基本面紮實，惟49倍本益比限制估值上行，須以穩定成長持續驗證溢價合理性。

需留意：本益比49.53倍，對零售業而言估值偏高。；薄商品毛利使獲利高度依賴會員費與來客量。；消費支出放緩可能影響非必需品銷售。

summary_en:
Costco slightly misses EPS, but its membership-retail model stays solid.
• EPS of $4.93 slightly missed the $4.97 estimate, a 0.85% shortfall.
• Quarterly revenue of $69.60B reflects steady member spending and traffic.
• Membership-fee income provides a high-margin, predictable profit base.
• High renewal rates reinforce revenue stickiness.
• Value positioning attracts consumers in an inflationary environment.

ai_view_en:
Signal neutral: EPS nearly met estimates with only a small miss, and the membership-retail model shows its usual stability and resilience. Near to mid-term, high renewal rates and membership-fee cash flow support the stock with good defensiveness. Focus is on comparable-sales momentum and potential earnings upside from a membership-fee increase. Track: comparable sales (with and without fuel), renewal rate, fee-increase timing, traffic, and average ticket. Fundamentals are solid, but a 49x P/E caps upside, requiring steady growth to justify the premium.

Watch：A P/E of 49.53 is high for the retail sector.; Thin merchandise margins make profit reliant on fees and traffic.; A consumer-spending slowdown could affect discretionary sales.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期：EPS驚喜-0.85%，幾乎符合，營收696.0億美元反映穩健客流。
